caption: The drawing depicts a garment created from a lavender or purple-colored fabric with a floral pattern in darker shades of green and purple. The object appears to be made up of two main panels joined at the top, with scalloped edges on the outer sides, outlined with a reddish trim. The left panel features an open zigzag pattern along its inner edge, exposing an underlying cream or pale pink fabric. At the top of the garment is a partial standing collar and upper section made from a fabric patterned with horizontal red and white stripes. The drawing has a plain beige background, and there is some cursive writing in the upper right corner.
title: Tea Apron
